executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain under high pressure. Server DRAM, DRAM and HBM are currently among the most constrained areas. The Daily Check from 2026-08-12 reviewed 8 relevant items; there is currently no confirmed material directional change. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will reach the market with a lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain critical.
